_comment: Copy to telegram_poller_config.json and fill in. Real config has credentials — keep out of git.
_creds_help: Get from https://my.telegram.org -> log in with phone -> API Development Tools -> Create application. api_id is an integer, api_hash is a hex string. One-time setup, free.
_session_help: Telethon session file (e.g. telegram_poller_session.session). First run prompts for phone number + SMS code; subsequent runs auto-login.
_channel_help: Each channel can be a public @username (string) or a numeric Telegram chat ID (int, often negative like -1001234567890 for channels). For private channels you're a member of, use the numeric ID — copy it from a t.me/c/<id>/<msg> URL.
_out_csv_help: Where to append parsed signals. Same format DiscoSignalReplay EA reads. Path above is Axi MT4.
_state_help: Stores next 'our msg id' counter. Telethon manages its own state in the .session file separately.
_symbol_filter_help: Only XAUUSD signals are appended to the inbox. Set to empty string to accept all symbols (EA will then filter).
